name: seungboshim-skills
description: Claude Code skills by seungboshim — Korean tone correction, feature workflows, design systems

plugins.name: korean-tone
plugins.description: 클로드의 딱딱한 한국어를 자연스럽게 교정한다. 번역투·수동태·한자어 과압축·내부 용어를 걷어내고, 코드 식별자는 그대로 지킨다. 저장되는 한국어 문서를 검사하는 tone-linter 훅이 함께 설치된다.

plugins.name: shimmy-tone
plugins.description: 개발 블로그(벨로그) 저술 보이스 — 비유·밈·반전으로 어려운 개념을 쉽게. korean-tone 위에 얹히는 개인화 스킬.

plugins.name: feature-flow
plugins.description: Full-cycle guide for building a single screen/feature — scope → plan → execute → review → commit → document, with a human checkpoint at each step.

plugins.name: feature-flow-superpowers
plugins.description: Superpowers-extended variant of feature-flow — each step explicitly calls matching superpowers skills (TDD, code review, verification).

plugins.name: daily
plugins.description: Session orientation + work recommendation — reads backlog, recent patch notes, and git state to answer "where am I" and "what should I work on".

plugins.name: worklog
plugins.description: Post-work documentation ritual — patch note, feature-spec update, and backlog tick in one pass.

plugins.name: tailwind-design-system
plugins.description: Design system builder and refactorer for Tailwind CSS + Next.js — style audit, semantic tokens, shared component extraction, migration.
